description: Hand-written baseline/patch pairs for the paper benchmark (docs/12 track 2). Sources: benchmarks/fixtures/seeded/<case>/{base,patch}; patch/ overlays base/. Labels, oracle inputs and the anticipated tool outcome were written before any InvariantGuard run on these cases; the manifest digest is recorded in docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md and in every result file. The author also wrote the tool, so the set reflects knowledge of its supported subset (threat to validity).

label_definitions.defect_introduced: some admitted input makes the base satisfy the property and the patch violate it (confirmed by execution)
label_definitions.no_defect_introduced: no such input on the finite grid; hand argument in the description (finite execution is corroboration, not proof)
label_definitions.intentional_change: behavior changes against an existing contract on purpose (documented API change); reported separately as false-block analysis

oracle_kinds.exception: failure iff the call raises one of failure_exceptions
oracle_kinds.sum_approx: failure iff the call raises, or the result is not a list of finite numbers whose sum is within atol + rtol*|target| of target
oracle_kinds.unchanged_argument: failure iff the call raises or the argument differs (==) from a deep copy taken before the call
oracle_kinds.length_preserved: failure iff the call raises or len(result) != len(xs)
oracle_kinds.all_between: failure iff the call raises or some result element is outside [lower, upper]
